hypothesis: At the same exact-half-support ternary and ratio-128 INT4 correction dimensions, adding a three-bit shared per-input gain to learned one-sparse signed Clark-Hash routing reduces heldout exported Qwen3.8-27B weight error by at least 0.5 percent against learned bucket-and-sign routing, with no tensor regressing by more than 1 percent, while counting every gain index and codebook byte and remaining below 1.57 component bits per weight

clark_hash_source.method_reused: sparse signed input-to-sketch routing plus a compact magnitude side channel
clark_hash_source.important_change: the paper stores one norm for a complete embedding; this experiment learns and quantizes one positive gain per input coordinate so residual columns can share direction without being forced to share magnitude

candidate.representation: W approximately equals T plus A R_gain, where each R_gain column has one learned bucket, sign, and quantized positive gain
candidate.gain_codebook: eight deterministic weighted-Lloyd FP16 levels shared across an input route
candidate.routing_training: fit one exact-half-support ternary baseline on training rows, then fit gain-aware signed prototype routing to its residual columns
candidate.heldout_fit: freeze route and gains, then alternate exact fixed-support ternary projection and exact gain-weighted coefficient means on evaluation rows
candidate.hash_coefficient_export: signed per-output-row INT4 with one FP16 scale
candidate.ternary_scale_storage_projection: one FP16 row anchor plus four-bit group ratio indices and one sixteen-entry FP16 tensor codebook

control.representation: identical learned one-sparse bucket-and-sign routing without per-input gains
control.training_residual: byte-identical training tensors and the same fixed-half-support ternary baseline as the gain candidate
control.heldout_fit: the same three fixed-route ternary and coefficient coordinate iterations
control.export: the same ternary FP16 scales and signed per-row INT4 coefficient quantizer

storage.gain_codebook: eight FP16 positive levels per route, conservatively charged independently to every tensor
storage.ternary_codes: exact fixed-support enumerative width ceil(log2(binomial(128,64) times 2^64))
